review.headline: Intervals completed as structured: 6.8 km total, reps averaged 4:00/km against a 3:55/km target, with the jog recoveries and cool-down in range.
observations: Warm-up 2.0 km at 5:45/km (HR 135), inside the easy band of 5:11-6:13/km.
Rep block 1.6 km at 4:00/km (HR 171, max 174), about 5 s/km off the 3:55/km target, so the reps were close to plan.
Jog recoveries 1.2 km at 6:20/km (HR 145), slightly slower than the easy band, which fits a genuine recovery.
Cool-down 2.0 km at 5:45/km (HR 142) was controlled and easy.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the effort on the reps is not confirmed.
Rep HR sat at 170-174 for much of the block, close to max; watch for recovery between sessions.
Week 3 is well behind plan: 15.8 km of 43.4 km and 2 of 7 sessions completed.
No runs logged since this session (none recorded after 2026-11-19 as of 2026-11-25), and CTL has fallen from 47.2 to 40.2 over the past week.
